"just had a release on our line near Edmonton, AB at 20:25 on Sept 10. volume metered at
166 m³. looks like it went off the ROW onto neighbouring land. still assessing the situation.
flange failure is suspected, possibly due to frozen gasket. ground was frozen solid in the area
and we had some pretty bad freeze-thaw issues last spring. will keep you posted on what's
going on. - J. Smith, Area Supervisor"
